title: “What's in a name?” SCA Shabbat Message by Terri Elmann

chapters.title: Listing of Yaakov's family and Rashi's question
Three things kept when leaving Egypt

summary: This class discusses the significance of names based on Parashat Shemot, exploring why Yaakov's family is listed again and how Bnei Yisrael maintained their identity during the Exodus by keeping their names, language, and clothing. It also examines the naming of Moshe by Bat Par'oh, the interpretation by Sforno, and the names of Shifrah and Puah according to Rashi.
questions: Why does the parashah list the members of Yaakov's family again if they were already listed in Vayigash?
What three things did Bnei Yisrael keep when they were leaving Egypt that saved them from the 49th level of purity?
Why did Bat Par'oh name Moshe as she did, according to Sforno?
Who were Shifrah and Puah according to Rashi, and how did they get their names?
